name: GST calculator
blurb: Add or remove GST from a price
intro: Find the GST on a bill. Add GST to a price, or take it out of a price that already has GST.

steps.title: Pick the GST rate
steps.body: Tap a rate, or type your own. Check the right rate for your item.

steps.title: Choose add or remove
steps.body: Add GST to a price, or remove GST from a price that already has it.

formula: Add GST: price with GST = price + price × rate ÷ 100. Remove GST: price before GST = price with GST × 100 ÷ (100 + rate). CGST and SGST are half of the GST each, for a sale within one state.
